sloka: आकाशाद्विघनात्तीव्रा उल्काश्चाभ्यपतंस्तदा ।वमन्त्यः पावकज्वालाः शिवा घोरं ववाशिरे ।। ६.५३.१४ ।।।।
transliteration: ākāśādvighanāttīvrā ulkāścābhyapataṁstadā ।vamantyaḥ pāvakajvālāḥ śivā ghoraṁ vavāśire ।। 6.53.14 ।।।।

translations.english: As they were leaving evil portents appeared. Dreadful jackals, dazzling fire from the sky and meteors falling appeared.
